body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the HBT8018 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance is 150 m. Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical cell is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Total Weight 6500 kg. If a distance cell is missing on the HBT8018 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto HBT8018 Concrete Pump. Keep the listed order. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei, China
